final_message: Fixed `late_fee` in `src/ledger/fees.py:14` — it now computes chargeable days as `max(0, days_late - grace_days)` instead of ignoring `grace_days` entirely. Added two regression tests in `tests/test_fees.py` covering the reported case (7 days late → $2.00) and the boundary case (exactly at grace period → $0.00). Full suite: 68 passed.
